TextBlock.Text: EASTERN BANDA CORRIDOR. The convoy has to cross a patrol box where the submarine and surface threats overlap, and after three weeks the Australian escort force cannot cover both. MOGAMI and MAYA are here under the Japanese government's own arrangements, with two SH-60Ks that are the best ASW asset in this sea. A Japanese F-2A detachment forward at Biak has one sortie allocation today and will use it on the surface group, not on your convoy's CAP. Get the priority cargo to the handover. The Type 039 is the threat that ends the mission; the fighters overhead are the threat that makes you spend the day looking up instead of down.
Cargo: The priority convoy reaches the handover point Allies: Keep the Japanese escorts in the fight Submarine: Locate and break off the submarine
JS Mogami and JS Maya with two SH-60K, one F-2A pair from Biak, HMAS Perth and the convoy. Opposing: a Type 039C, a J-11BG pair, a J-11BS, a Su-27UBK and a J-10C off the enclave field.
75 minutes. The operation ends when the clock runs out, and the main objective fails with it.

SEST JMSDF Mogami, Euromod - Modern Japanese Maritime Self Defence Force, SEST RAN Fleet, F-2A 'Viper Zero', Auxilliary Merchant Pack, Merchants Expanded, RE-power: the resupply mod, PLAN Submarines, Shenyang J-11, PLA Shenyang J-11BS, PLA Sukhoi Su-27UBK, ChengDu J-10C Vigorous Dragon, PLA Land Unit Pack, Boeing P-8 Poseidon, SEST RAAF Bases.
